Life is full of small surprises. David learned a lot about music. Both of them like chicken and coffee. Also, scientists study how the universe began.
They took many photos at the bird-watching spot. David bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. David drinks coffee after doing sports. Also, the peacock spread its bright tail.

David thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike. There are always many people at the bird-watching spot. Also, penguins waddle across the ice.
David hopes to visit Chengdu one day. David wants to be a nurse in the future. David and Ben had great fun there.
